B.freight.port_osm_node_id.description: Acquired OSM locality point named Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust; nearest connected modal link is a provisional port access anchor.

B.freight.gate_axes.description: Research-network extremities proxy external gates; they are not observed freight destinations.

B.freight.car_equivalent_movements_per_p.description: Smoke intensity proxy for applying the observed classified-site goods/car ratio to the explicit small resident population.
B.freight.car_equivalent_movements_per_p.sweep_basis: Provisional background freight sensitivity; not a calibrated regional freight forecast.

B.freight.goods_count_classes.description: Use unambiguous goods groups; the mixed Others/MAV group is excluded.

B.freight.reference_car_class.description: Denominator of the historical goods/car ratio.

B.freight.rake_movements_per_handled_rak.description: Stationary port-operation proxy: one inbound and one outbound movement per handled rake; handled-day reports are not themselves movement counts.
B.freight.rake_movements_per_handled_rak.sweep_basis: Provisional background freight sensitivity; not a calibrated regional freight forecast.

B.freight.movement_window_s.description: Provisional all-day release window; actual dispatch and road time restrictions still require integration.
B.freight.movement_window_s.sweep_basis: Provisional background freight sensitivity; not a calibrated regional freight forecast.

B.freight.port_snap_limit_m.description: Fail if the port locality is too far from a connected modal network; snapping is a provisional access representation.
B.freight.port_snap_limit_m.sweep_basis: Provisional background freight sensitivity; not a calibrated regional freight forecast.
